variants.displayName: Orange Lvl. Contract: Defend [Objects] and Escort Employees
variants.briefing:
We need a contractor to provide convoy and protection services at [Location]. One of our elite clients' are under attack from a band of outlaws targeting their [Objects] and ships. You'll need to keep the crew safe as they traverse the area, as well as make sure the assets stay as intact. These thugs look like they can do some real damage, so be sure you engage them with caution or the client might not be the only one to take heavy losses.

If you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering [ScripAmount] MG Scrip as compensation to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

variants.displayName: Red Lvl. Contract: Protect [Objects] and Escort Employees
variants.briefing:
An emergency SOS just came through from a maintenance crew under the employ of one of Foxwell's VIP clients. If available, we urge you to get to [Location] as soon as possible. While engaging with the attackers, you'll be expected to protect the client’s  [Objects] and of their ships that may need assistance. 

This is far from the first we've seen from these particular outlaws, so believe me when I say these pilots are not to be taken lightly. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site.

If you manage to successfully defend the client's interests, we’re offering [ScripAmount] MG Scrip as compensation to the main contractor brave enough to take this job on. 

Stay safe, and good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
